name: Oracle HCM
tagline: Fusion HCM Cloud for functional consultants in Egypt and the Gulf
blurb: The three modules junior consultants are hired for — Core HR, Absence and Payroll — plus the Egyptian and Saudi statutory knowledge Oracle does not ship in the product.

functional.name: Functional
functional.blurb: What the business configures and runs: the structures people sit in, the record that describes them, and the money, time and law that follow.

technical.name: Technical
technical.blurb: What the consultant builds with: loading data in bulk, writing the calculation logic, getting information back out, extending without customizing, and controlling who sees what.

name: Data & Analytics
tagline: SQL, Power BI and Excel — the analyst's toolkit, and when to reach for which
blurb: The three tools every analytics job posting names, treated as one craft: get the rows out with SQL, model and publish them in Power BI, and know what Excel is still the fastest answer to.

functional.name: Foundations
functional.blurb: How to think about data before you touch a tool: what a row means, what a spreadsheet is still best at, and how a question becomes a chart someone trusts.

technical.name: Tools
technical.blurb: The three the job postings name. SQL to get the rows out, Power BI to model and publish them, and the language underneath it that decides what a number means.
